description.value: Super 8 by Wyndham is a budget-friendly motel chain property situated on Victoria Street West at the western approach to Revelstoke, a town that serves as a natural hub for cyclists exploring the Columbia River valley and the surrounding mountain routes. As part of the Wyndham Rewards program, guests can earn points toward future stays. The motel offers standard roadside accommodation in a community well-positioned between Rogers Pass and the Okanagan.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The fetched website content is almost entirely Wyndham Hotels navigation boilerplate — no property-specific amenity detail (breakfast, bike storage, laundry, etc.) is present in any of the subpages retrieved. OSM provides internet_access=wlan but rules prohibit treating OSM amenity tags as authoritative without website confirmation, so Wi-Fi is left null. The property is clearly a real, active Super 8 franchise motel in Revelstoke; confirmed_open is set to true based on the live Wyndham booking page resolving correctly for this property.
concerns: The OSM phone number (+1-866-926-0888) appears to be a Wyndham central reservations toll-free line rather than a direct hotel number; the direct property number is not confirmed from website content.
All fetched website subpages returned generic Wyndham brand navigation boilerplate with no property-specific amenity detail, leaving nearly all amenity fields unverifiable.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active motel franchise in a key cycling hub town; no indication of closure or phantom listing.
